description: L1 Domain — Primary question: Какие providers/adapters деградируют, лимитируют или возвращают ошибки? Decision supported: tune backoff/rate-limit, rotate credentials, pause provider, investigate external API, inspect circuit breaker.

panels.description: Current health state per provider. 0=UNHEALTHY, 1=DEGRADED, 2=HEALTHY.
panels.title: Current Provider Health Status

panels.description: Failure rate = failures / total checks (selected range). Warning >=5%, critical >=20%.

targets.expr: (sum(increase(bioetl_health_check_failures_total{provider=~"$provider"}[$__range])) or vector(0)) / clamp_min((sum(increase(bioetl_health_check_success_total{provider=~"$provider"}[$__range])) or vector(0)) + (sum(increase(bioetl_health_check_degraded_total{provider=~"$provider"}[$__range])) or vector(0)) + (sum(increase(bioetl_health_check_failures_total{provider=~"$provider"}[$__range])) or vector(0)), 1)

panels.title: Provider Failure Rate

panels.description: Total retry exhaustions in selected range. Red >= 1 means at least one operation gave up.
panels.title: Retries Exhausted

panels.description: HTTP error rate = errors / (errors + successful requests) in selected range. Red > 10%.

targets.expr: (sum(increase(bioetl_http_request_errors_total{provider=~"$provider"}[$__range])) or vector(0)) / clamp_min((sum(increase(bioetl_http_request_errors_total{provider=~"$provider"}[$__range])) or vector(0)) + (sum(increase(bioetl_adapter_requests_total{provider=~"$provider"}[$__range])) or vector(0)), 1)

panels.title: HTTP Error Rate

panels.description: Minimum tokens available across providers in the last 15m. Red < 1 means rate limiter depleted.
panels.title: Rate Limiter Tokens Depleted

panels.description: Circuit breaker state: 0=closed, 1=half-open, 2=open. Red when open.
panels.title: Circuit Breaker Open

panels.description: Health check latency quantiles (p50/p95/p99) per provider over rate interval.
panels.title: Health Check Latency p50 / p95 / p99

panels.description: Adapter request latency quantiles (p50/p95/p99) per provider and endpoint over rate interval.
panels.title: Adapter Request Latency p50 / p95 / p99

panels.description: Rate limiter wait quantiles (p50/p95/p99) per provider over rate interval.
panels.title: Rate Limiter Wait p50 / p95 / p99

panels.description: Failure and degraded health check counts per interval by provider.
panels.title: Failure & Degraded Trend by Provider

panels.description: Retry exhaustion trend per provider/operation over time.
panels.title: Retries Exhausted Trend by Provider / Operation

panels.description: HTTP request errors by method and error type per interval.

targets.expr: round(sum by (provider, method, error_type) (increase(bioetl_http_request_errors_total{provider=~"$provider"}[$__interval])) or vector(0))

panels.title: HTTP Errors by Method / Error Type

panels.description: Adapter error taxonomy breakdown by provider, operation, error_category, and error_type (selected range).

targets.expr: round(sum by (provider, operation, error_category, error_type) (increase(bioetl_adapter_error_taxonomy_total{provider=~"$provider"}[$__range])) or vector(0))

panels.title: Adapter Error Taxonomy

panels.description: Retries attempted vs retry exhaustions vs HTTP errors — compare retry policy behavior (selected range).

targets.expr: round(sum by (provider, method, error_type) (increase(bioetl_http_request_errors_total{provider=~"$provider"}[$__range])) or vector(0))

panels.title: Retry Attempts vs Failures

panels.description: Failure share by provider as percentage of total failures (selected range).
panels.title: Provider Failure Share (Selected Range)

panels.description: Retries exhausted by provider and operation (instant table, selected range).
panels.title: Retries Exhausted by Provider / Operation

panels.description: HTTP retry budget exhaustion count by provider and method (selected range).
panels.title: HTTP Retry Budget Exhausted

panels.description: Circuit breaker state (max) per adapter over selected range.
panels.title: Circuit Breaker State (max)

panels.description: Circuit breaker trip count per adapter over time.
panels.title: Circuit Breaker Trips by Provider

panels.description: Minimum rate limiter tokens available per provider (15m window).
panels.title: Minimum Rate Limiter Tokens Available
